suppress.notes: JavaZoom JLayer is an MP3 decoder. Dependency-Check incorrectly assigns the unrelated Zoom video-conferencing CPE and its vulnerabilities.

This artifact contains CEF 146.0.10 / Chromium 146.0.7680.179. The two CEF vulnerabilities affect versions before 121 and are fixed in 120.2.3, 121.2.6, and newer. Dependency-Check truncates the compound artifact version.

These findings concern Kotlin compiler/build tooling: insecure temporary-file creation and unsafe deserialization of build-cache metadata. Chat4J carries only the Kotlin runtime libraries transitively; it does not compile Kotlin or consume Kotlin build-cache metadata at runtime.
